get_email_event_settings: get all email event settings from the litellm proxy database
update_email_event_settings: update email event settings for specific events via PATCH request
reset_email_event_settings: reset all email event settings back to their default values
get_email_settings_from_db: retrieve email settings from general_settings in the prisma database
save_email_settings_to_db: persist email settings to general_settings in the prisma database
